过度依赖手机

原题（中文）

越来越多的中国人现在的确离不开手机了。他们中的许多人，包括老年人，都使用手机应用程序保持联系并拓宽朋友圈。他们也用手机购物，查找信息，因为手机便于携带。此外，使用手机应用程序通信比传统电话便宜。然而，这种新趋势导致人们在社交时过度依赖手机。事实上，一些年轻人已经变得十分上瘾，以至于怠慢了与家人和朋友面对面的交流。

你的译文

More and more chinese people couldn't depart from mobile phone now.Many of them,include elder,all use mobile phone application to keep relationship with their friends,and explore new friends.They also use mobile phone for shopping,searching information,beacuse mobile phone is easy to carry on.Elsewhere,using mobile phone application for cooperation is cheaper than trodational telephone.But,this tendency cause people too rely on mobile phone in social.In face,some young are so excessed in using mobile phone,that they delay the communication of face to face with their family and friends

批改

总评

意思基本全部传达到位，七句话的信息点没有遗漏，这是最重要的。但拼写错误 3 处、语法硬伤 6 处、标点缺空格贯穿全文，四级评分档次上会从「切题达意」被拉到 7-9 分档（满分 15）。先把下面的硬伤清掉，分数能上 11 分档。

一、拼写错误（最容易丢分，扣分最狠）

  1. chinese → Chinese（国家/民族形容词首字母必须大写）
  2. beacuse → because
  3. trodational → traditional
  4. In face → In fact（这是「事实上」，写成 In face 意思全变了）

二、语法硬伤

  1. 时态：couldn't depart from → can hardly leave。原文是「现在的确离不开」，讲的是当下状态，用现在时；你用了过去时 couldn't，时态错了。
  2. 非谓语：include elder → including the elderly。作插入语要用现在分词 including；「老年人」是 the elderly（the + 形容词表一类人），elder 单独用是「长辈/年长者」且需加 s。
  3. 主谓一致：this tendency cause → this trend causes（第三人称单数）。
  4. 副词位置：too rely on → rely too much on 或 over-rely on。too 不能直接修饰动词。
  5. so...that 结构用词：are so excessed in using → have become so addicted。excessed 不是这么用的动词（excess 是名词/形容词）；「上瘾」标准说法是 be/become addicted to。
  6. 并列结构不一致：use mobile phone for shopping, searching information → use their phones for shopping and searching for information。for 后要么全用动名词并列，要么用不定式；另外 search 是不及物动词，查找信息要 search for information。

三、用词与搭配

  1. depart from mobile phone → leave their phones / live without their phones。depart from 是「从某地出发/背离（原则）」，不用于「离不开手机」。
  2. keep relationship with their friends → keep in touch。原文「保持联系」的固定表达就是 keep in touch。
  3. explore new friends → broaden their circle of friends。原文是「拓宽朋友圈」，explore friends 不成立。
  4. easy to carry on → easy to carry。carry on 是「继续做某事」，多一个 on 意思全变。
  5. Elsewhere → Besides / Moreover / In addition。原文「此外」是递进连接词；Elsewhere 是「在别处」，用错了。
  6. cooperation（合作）→ communication（通信）。这个词错得最要命——原句是「用手机应用程序通信比传统电话便宜」，写成 cooperation 完全变成另一个意思。
  7. in social → when socializing / in social interactions。social 是形容词，不能单独作 in 的宾语。
  8. some young → some young people。young 作形容词，后面要跟名词。
  9. delay the communication of face to face → neglect face-to-face communication。「怠慢」是 neglect（忽视），不是 delay（推迟）；face-to-face 作定语要连字符前置。
  10. all use 中的 all 冗余，前面已有 Many of them，删掉。

四、格式细节

  • 标点后缺空格：now.Many / them,include / shopping,searching / But,this——英文标点后必须空一格，全文有 10 余处。这在阅卷时是明显的书写规范扣分点。
  • 结尾漏句号。

亮点（值得保持）

  • 信息完整度高，七个分句一个没漏，包括「便于携带」「比传统电话便宜」这类容易跳过的细节。
  • More and more 开头、than 比较结构、so...that 结构的框架都用对了，说明句型意识在，问题主要出在词汇准确度和拼写。
  • 敢用 tendency / excessive 这类稍难的词，方向对，只是形式没掌握牢——建议这类词记的时候连词性一起记。

下一步建议

你的瓶颈很清楚：不是句子写不出来，是词形和搭配不准。针对性练习：把这篇里错的 10 个搭配（keep in touch / broaden one's circle of friends / be addicted to / search for / face-to-face / rely too much on / easy to carry / traditional / including / the elderly）抄下来，明天默写一遍。四级翻译的高频词就这些，反复出现。

参考译文

More and more Chinese people can hardly leave their phones now. Many of them, including the elderly, use mobile phone apps to keep in touch and to broaden their circle of friends. They also use their phones for shopping and searching for information, because phones are easy to carry. Besides, communication by mobile apps is cheaper than that by traditional phones. However, this new trend makes people rely too much on their phones when socializing. In fact, some young people have become so addicted that they neglect face-to-face communication with their family members and friends.

result.html:
翻译练习 · 卢沟桥（Lugou Bridge）

原题（中文）

卢沟桥（Lugou Bridge）位于北京西南15公里处，始建于1189年，距今已有800多年的历史。桥上建有大量雕刻精美、形态各异的石狮子，因此民间有“卢沟桥的狮子——数不清”的歇后语。这座桥不仅以其建筑艺术闻名，也因1937年发生的“卢沟桥事变”而具有重要历史意义。

你的译文

Lugou Bridge is located in 15 kilometers southwest of Beijing. It was built in 1189 and has more than 800 years history. There are many stone lions on the bridge with different beautiful shapes, so people say the lions on Lugou Bridge cannot be counted. The bridge is famous for its building art and also important because the Lugou Bridge Incident happened there in 1937.

批改

主要问题

  1. 介词冗余：located in 15 kilometers southwest of Beijing → located 15 kilometers southwest of Beijing（locate 表方位时不用 in）。
  2. 数词搭配：has more than 800 years history → has a history of over 800 years（或 more than 800 years of history）。
  3. 用词不准：building art → architectural art 更地道；different beautiful shapes → various postures（石狮子用 postures 更贴切形态各异）。
  4. 歇后语处理：cannot be counted 意思到但丢失了“数不清”的俗语感，参考译文用 folk simile 更传神。
  5. 句式：also important because... 可升级为 also significant in that... 或 for its historic significance。

亮点

  • 时态正确，核心信息（位置/年代/石狮/1937事变）全部覆盖，专有名词 Lugou Bridge Incident 使用准确。整体已达 CET-4 及格水平，扣分点主要在搭配与用词精度。

参考译文

Lugou Bridge is located about 15 kilometers southwest of Beijing. First built in 1189, it has a history of over 800 years. The bridge is decorated with a great number of exquisitely carved stone lions in various postures, which gave rise to the folk simile "the lions on Lugou Bridge — too many to count." The bridge is famous not only for its architectural art but also for its historic significance, as the Lugou Bridge Incident took place there in 1937.
